Hey fellow players playing Outside, I have added a few more bullets to the sidebar of this subverse because of people asking for them to be added. Please let me know what you think of them and if any more rules should be added!

Guidlines and suggestions for good comments/submissions:

  • The game is supposedly developed by Deity Games, and many people have different opinions on what exactly Deity Games is. Some people believe that there is only one developer, while others think that there are many, and some people even think that there are no developers at all and that the game is in fact player made.

  • Submissions and comments should follow the "spirit" of the subverse. The moderator(s) of this subverse reserve the right to remove any posts that do not do this.

  • Do not call other players NPCs. You can call animals NPCs, even though some players believe that animals are players and should be treated as such.

  • The devs are lazy and rarely do much. The game is mostly balanced as it is according to them, therefore they don't do much aside from "natural" world events.

  • The whole game is played on one "server". Another region is not in a different server than your region. Some players believe that there are parallel servers to us. Some players believe that your player goes to a different server after your player dies, although these may not be necessarily called "servers".

  • The game is mostly run by the players.

  • There are no "in-game moderators or admins"; there are players with more power than the average player. Police officers, lawyers, politicians, celebrities (except Chuck Norris) and the like are other players. They aren't technically moderators or admins.

  • The game runs on the Physics engine

  • Try to treat bugs and glitches as features. It's a lot more fun explaining them that way. I'll try to be flexible with this rule.

  • The moderator(s) of this subverse also reserve the right to remove any posts that do not follow these guidlines. (I will also try to be flexible with this rule. If a post doesn't follow some points but is still funny, like this, I might leave it).

  • Please keep al meta posts in the meta thread. The current meta thread is:

  • Breaking in game rules set by factions isn't "hacking". For example: You could call someone like Jesus a hacker because he supposedly broke an in-game rule by coming back to life (again, not all players believe that this actually happened).
